places.displayName: Stanisław Staszic Gymnasium, Polna 60 / Noakowskiego 6, Warsaw
places.authorizedName: Gimnazjum im. Stanisława Staszica w Warszawie, ul. Polna 60
places.publicNote: The Staszic school was associated with Kaper’s secondary education and matura. Its building at Polna 60 was completed in 1916, after the start of the 1915/16 school year; the site is linked to his transfer as the school’s later home, not as a confirmed location of the transfer. Part of Polna Street was renamed for Stanisław Noakowski in 1938, giving the same site the address Noakowskiego 6. Warszawa1939.pl documents it under the later address and cites a history using both forms. Burned after the Warsaw Uprising, the building was rebuilt and given an additional storey. The coordinates indicate the address area.
Sienna 44 is associated with Kaper’s birthplace in Warsaw. The coordinates indicate the address area; exact continuity between the 1902 property and the modern address point remains unverified.

places.displayName: A. M. Skrynnikow Real School, Żórawia 49, Warsaw
places.authorizedName: Szkoła realna A. M. Skrynnikowa w Warszawie, ul. Żórawia 49 / Żurawia 49
places.publicNote: Kaper attended this Warsaw school before transferring to the Staszic school. It was at ul. Żórawia 49, now Żurawia 49. The coordinates indicate the address area; survival of the historical school building has not been established.
